I used my finger to try to get the air bubble out and it did not work. A credit card also did not work to remove the air bubble. It was just moving the bubble to the surrounding areas. Since this box came with 3 screen protectors, I took this screen protector off and I now had one last chance to get it right. During the final application, once again following the directions for a second time on my iPhone 11, the same problem occurred, but now the air bubble was on the lower portion of the screen (see image).
